title: Copy Editor & Writer
description:
• Comfort in using content management systems.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The copy editor/writer ensures compliance with Howard.edu style and brand guidelines, Associated Press, and other written communication conventions and standard rules of grammar. This employee also reviews digital content to ensure certain search engine optimization models are followed and that hyperlinks are functional and accurate. Editing assignments will often be time sensitive and require a short turn around. The copy editor/writer also plans and develops assigned content projects, such as articles for the website and Howard Magazine, that enhance the institution's visibility and reputation, conveys its mission, key messages, and initiatives to external and internal audiences. This function is core to OUC’s role in distributing knowledge and information to a wide range of audiences based on Howard University programs and priorities. The ideal candidate is an extremely strong writer with demonstrated expertise in grammar and style conventions and a passion for details. The ideal candidate is also an experienced storyteller in all stages of content development and project management, from story ideation to publishing. The incumbent will work closely with colleagues who have functional expertise in multimedia (photography, video, digital distribution, etc.), as well as various campus stakeholders and media outlets to ensure timely and accurate dissemination of news and information about the University.

Supervisory Accountability

Reports to the Director of Editorial Services. May supervise interns or student workers upon need.

Nature And Scope

Reviews editorial content submitted by OUC team members and other members of the campus community to ensure adherence to standard grammar rules and designated style conventions. Also develops relationships with campus subject matter experts and program leaders to identify and develop stories which support Howard’s key messages, with emphasis on framing to achieve relevance, resonance, and engagement with key audiences.

Principal Accountabilities

Editing and Proofreading (75%)

  • Proofreads and edits written copy to eliminate grammatical and typographic errors. This copy includes stories submitted for publication on the University website and printed magazines, social media posts, media releases, internal announcements, brochures, fact sheets, event programs, letters to the community, strategic messages and executive level remarks and speeches.
  • Proofreads and edits written copy for institutional printed publications, including headers, main body copy, captions, and references.
  • Provides guidance with regards to preferred style conventions, especially Associated Press guidelines.

Writing and Publishing (20%)

  • Writes articles which serve as proof points in support of Howard’s key messages, particularly those related to research, impact, excellence, and influence.
  • Performs extensive research to find areas where Howard has unique expertise, stories, and historical perspectives.
  • Fact checks story details to ensure accuracy, transparency, and authority.
  • Interviews subject matter experts, sources, students, faculty, stakeholders, and administrators, as well as external sources with relevance to a story.
  • Finalizes copy and stories for posting on websites, with specific attention to search engine optimization tactics including linking, metadata, and headers.
  • Integrates stories into messaging platforms which promote related university programs and initiatives.
  • Prepares stories for publication in Howard Magazine and other publications.
  • Edits stories to ensure readability, correct grammar and punctuation, typographical error elimination, and adherence to designated style guidelines.
  • Develops story headlines for digital platforms which garner interest and engagement with targeted audiences.
  • Maintains a database of subject matter experts and cultivates relationships with key faculty members, student organizations, and campus leadership.
  • Monitors trending news, blog, and social media topics to determine ways to maximize visibility and engagement through storytelling.

Project Orchestration and Management (5%)

  • Develops story ideas and pitches them to team leadership, including, in some cases, full storyboarding.
  • Outlines components for comprehensive storytelling, including multimedia elements which accompany written copy.
  • Communicates specific multimedia direction, including photography, infographics, and video guidance.
  • Works with members of divisional teams with responsibility for multimedia content production to ensure initiation, execution, completion, and delivery.
  • Develops, communicates, and manages an audience targeting strategy for each article, including distribution methodology, promotion tactics, and schedules.
  • In the absence of divisional or contracted photographer or videographer availability, captures images and video needed to convey story sentiment.
  • When necessary, edits photos or videos for suitable placement in alignment with stories.
  • Crops photos for usage in digital stories in accordance with content management system standards.
  • Uploads photos and videos for usage in digital stories.
  • Monitor audience engagement using metrics and data analysis tools.

Core Competencies

  • Extremely strong proofreading and editing skills, with a high degree of proficiency in grammar usage.
  • Extremely strong writing skills, with proficiency in AP Style.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to provide written and verbal feedback.
  • Ability to gain a thorough understanding of University’s visions, mission, goals, and objectives.
  • Research and interview skills.
  • Comfort in using content management systems.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and scientific subject matter for easy comprehension by readers with as little as a seventh-grade education.
  • Proficiency in search engine optimization.
  • Comfort in adhering to deadlines. Must be able to manage shifting priorities.
  • Adaptability in working both within long-term, systematic plans and in a time-sensitive environment with tight turnaround based on emerging circumstances.
  • Ability to work as a team member and establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with students, faculty, staff, University officials and the general public. Ability to meet with people of diverse backgrounds to secure information in order to develop high-quality content.
  • Ability to use sound judgment and make decisions that demonstrate strong problem-solving ability, adaptability, and responsiveness to change. Ability to exercise critical and analytical thinking while working with independence within a defined scope that elevates and protects the University’s reputation.
  • Ability to assist in the management of complex projects and to construct professional level material on short deadlines. Ability to follow established priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver quality customer service.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in English, humanities, journalism, communications, public relations or related field, and two years of professional experience in an editorial environment or equivalent combination of three (3) years combined relevant training and experience. Experience in education, higher education, media organizations, public relations or strategic communications firms preferred. Master’s degree in English, communications, journalism, or a related field, preferred, but not required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $60,000 - $65,000

The cluster aims to strengthen university-wide research capacity by recruiting faculty whose scholarship advances mathematical foundations, modeling, and computational methodologies that support AI-driven biomedical discovery, while fostering collaboration across disciplines.

From a mathematics-centered perspective, this position emphasizes the development and application of mathematical theory, statistical modeling, and computational methods that underpin modern AI and machine learning approaches in biomedical sciences. The cluster seeks to advance quantitative frameworks for imaging, inference, prediction, and decision-making in complex biological and clinical systems. The successful candidate will contribute to an interdisciplinary academic environment through research, teaching, mentorship, and collaboration. Resumo da vaga

Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) – Rio. A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica náutica com mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo Américas, África, Ásia e Europa. A Mackay oferece salários competitivos, além de horas extras, e benefícios como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias remuneradas, vale-refeição e vale-transporte. A Mackay está buscando um Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) para o setor náutico, com experiência e proficiência em inglês, para trabalhar presencialmente em nossa unidade no Rio de Janeiro. Candidatos com as habilidades e qualificações descritas abaixo são encorajados a se candidatar.

Resumo da vaga de Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC)

O Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) é um cargo presencial, sem função gerencial, que se reporta ao Diretor Geral do Brasil. As responsabilidades incluem comunicação direta com clientes para responder a perguntas sobre disponibilidade, preço e uso de produtos, bem como fornecer orientação técnica, orçamentos em tempo hábil e propostas abrangentes. Processará transações no balcão, pedidos especiais, pedidos de vendas por telefone e internet, bem como transferências entre empresas. Dará suporte a outros membros da equipe, clientes e contas da empresa com pedidos e entrega de peças para apoiar nossos negócios. Além disso, o manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como ponto de contato para vendas, serviços e solicitações de informações do cliente para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com rapidez e profissionalismo.
  • Auxiliar na pesquisa de problemas técnicos básicos sobre produtos e serviços. Coletar sintomas de problemas do cliente e facilitar os reparos.
  • Auxiliar no atendimento de clientes em potencial ou ligações de clientes quando a equipe de vendas externas estiver fora do escritório.
  • Fornecer orçamentos e propostas aos clientes e realizar o acompanhamento em tempo hábil.
  • Desenvolver o negócio identificando oportunidades de receita no setor náutico.
  • Auxiliar nas funções de expedição e recebimento para facilitar o fluxo e a contabilização de todos os materiais recebidos e entregues para pedidos de clientes, estoque, reparos ou uso interno.
  • Direcionar solicitações de serviço ao membro da equipe apropriado.
  • Manter a área de trabalho e o estoque limpos e organizados.
  • Ler pedidos de clientes, ordens de serviço, ordens de envio ou requisições para determinar os itens a serem movidos, coletados, distribuídos e/ou enviados, utilizando o sistema ERP da Mackay.

Habilidades necessárias

  • Conhecimento prévio de equipamentos eletrônicos náuticos é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos como folhetos de produtos, instruções de operação e manutenção, manuais de procedimentos, etc.
  • Capacidade de somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir em todas as unidades de medida, utilizando números inteiros, frações comuns e decimais. Capacidade de calcular taxas, proporções e porcentagens.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar materiais de forma eficaz e eficiente.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação (oral e escrita), organização, planejamento e priorização.

Qualificações

  • Dois anos de ensino superior.
  • Experiência na área de eletrônica e/ou náutica é desejável.
  • Três anos de experiência em vendas internas ou no balcão.
  • Bons conhecimentos de informática e internet.
  • Carteira de habilitação válida e veículo próprio.

Os candidatos devem estar autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil sem necessidade de patrocínio. A aprovação em uma verificação completa de antecedentes será exigida após a aceitação da oferta de emprego.

Gostou? Prazer, somos a Cury, venha fazer parte da nossa história!

Processo seletivo

Ah... pessoas com deficiências são super bem-vindas, viu?

Um estudo recente do LinkedIn indicou que mulheres são menos propensas a se candidatarem a vagas se não acreditarem que preenchem 100% das qualificações. A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP, com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado. Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental. Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade. Ser diverso é ser Super!

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

OBJETIVO DO CARGO: Garantir o planejamento eficiente dos abastecimentos de GLP dos clientes da Venda Indireta, otimizando o uso da frota, tempo e recursos logísticos. O programador é responsável por planejar as rotas de distribuição que atendam aos pedidos dos clientes com precisão de volume e prazo, respeitando as normas de segurança e os limites operacionais. Seu trabalho é essencial para garantir a fluidez das operações, o cumprimento dos SLA’s de entrega e a satisfação do cliente.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Planejar as rotas de abastecimento com base nos pedidos recebidos, capacidade da frota e restrições operacionais.
  • Utilizar sistemas de roteirização e gestão logística para otimizar trajetos e reduzir custos.
  • Garantir que as rotas estejam alinhadas com os prazos de entrega e volumes solicitados pelos clientes.
  • Ajustar as rotas conforme imprevistos operacionais (faltas, avarias, restrições de trânsito, etc.).
  • Interagir com a área comercial, operacional e cliente para garantir a execução das rotas conforme planejado.
  • Realizar análise de performance das rotas e propor melhorias contínuas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Logística, Engenharias, Administração e áreas afins.
  • Pacote Office Intermediário.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Na Supergasbras, nós reconhecemos e apoiamos a dedicação dos nossos colaboradores com excelentes benefícios e programas.

  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Gympass

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world's trade is carried by sea?

We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonize the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsilä’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Main Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.

Required Qualifications

  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • LL.M. degree required.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practicing attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.

Why join us

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

Last application date: 17/04/2026

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Incumbent serves as a member of the president’s cabinet and senior management team with authority over a wide range of policy issues; organizational, management and technical assignments, and special projects that may be on-going or non-recurring in nature. The individual will also oversee the management of the staff assigned to the Office of the President and its unique functions.

Dimensions

Supervise the work of office staff, professionals, consultants and students. Manage and organize priority projects, initiatives, and workflow for the Office of the President.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include the Board of Trustees, President, executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university. External contacts include parents, consultants, auditors, government officials, representatives from financial institutions, investment managers, law firms, alumni, donors, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • The Chief of Staff is responsible for overseeing and directing the operations of the President’s Office providing executive level support to the President serving as a senior advisor with regard to policy formulation, alternative and option analysis, and ensuring the decisions of the president are implemented in a timely manner and in accordance with direction given.
  • The Chief of staff represents the president’s position to internal and external stakeholders on matters of university policy and practice and serves as the president’s liaison to various University-related committees. The Chief of Staff also consistently interfaces with the President’s Cabinet to ensure that key issues are being proactively addressed.
  • The Chief of Staff will manage the flow of communication in and out of the President’s office to ensure consistent and responsive message delivery to key University stakeholders, including faculty, staff, students, alumni and other external constituents as appropriate.
  • Assist in planning (including strategic planning) and developing and establishing policies and goals consistent with organizational objectives and governmental regulations.
  • Generate, schedule, track, and coordinate assignments, as needed across stakeholder groups. Work independently to complete assignments involving the appropriate internal or external contacts.
  • Coordinate comprehensive projects and assignments that require collaboration of several different offices and/or areas of the University including personnel/management reviews, and special studies.
  • Prepare agendas for each Cabinet or other executive meetings and provide a summary of discussions and action items resulting from each meeting to attendees, ensuring appropriate follow-up as required.
  • Conduct data analysis, research, and write reports for use in executive decision-making. Handle data, communication and projects that are highly privileged and confidential.
  • Provide leadership in the development and administration of University or division-wide integrated plans and processes, i.e., accreditation assessments and performance evaluation reviews.
  • Build and maintain mutually supportive relationships with all levels of management, staff, outside agencies and vendors, when necessary. Work to remove barriers that hamper inter-and intra-department communications. Coordinate and monitor assignments which must be accomplished in conjunction with other senior executives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the principles, practices and methods employed in senior and executive level management.
  • Keen and demonstrated understanding of higher education structures, systems, strategies, policies, and procedures.
  • Computer and Internet research skills (including Microsoft Office Suite; spreadsheet, and presentation)
  • Skill in management and leadership with the ability to direct programs, staff, and cross-functional teams in an efficient and effective manner.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skill including tact, patience, and acumen and the ability to work with many, diverse individuals across various functions.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skill and ability to formulate recommendations.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills including correspondence writing, professional presentation development.
  • Ability to prioritize work follow-through with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to use a great deal of initiative work effectively under pressure and handle multiple simultaneous tasks and demands.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious relations with students, faculty, staff, University officials and the general public.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment; and commitment to completing tasks to the highest standards.
  • Highest level of integrity and management of confidential information

Minimum Requirements

Master’s Degree in Business/Public Administration or related field, and 7 years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of 10 years combined relevant training and experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $200,000 - $225,000

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.
  • No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8‑figure ARR, and is doubling year over year – with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify. We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We’re targeting 2× customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there. We’re capital‑efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion‑driven: make the signup‑to‑checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols. Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can’t optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built‑in quality check. You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company’s top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols.
  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking.
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Deliver protocol‑level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude.
  • Ship full‑stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React.
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations.
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate.
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations.
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on.
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment.
  • Drive adoption of AI‑assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity.

Our Tech Stack

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux‑loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI‑assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)

  • You’ve led a team of 4‑8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained.
  • You’ve shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture).
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). JavaScript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade‑offs to a PM who wants to ship faster.
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features.
  • You’re comfortable with event‑sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams.
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team’s development process.

Nice To Have (strongly Preferred)

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce.
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations.
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure.

How We Work

  • Remote, Americas‑based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones).
  • Two‑week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together.
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day.

World‑Class Benefits

  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada).
  • Flexible vacation/time‑off policies.
  • Equity into the company in the form of high‑potential stock options.
  • Liquidity of options whenever available.
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees).

Interview process

Do you believe you’re a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We’d love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

  • Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data‑driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  • First Interview (30min): Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be an exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60min): You will then meet with Mark P – Head of Engineering to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design and technical decisions as well as discussion around leading a team, growing engineers, hiring, AI adoption, and other aspects of people leadership.
  • Technical Interview (60min): Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands‑on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free to use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  • Product Interview (45min): You will chat with Steve C – Senior Growth Product Manager who will dive into your collaboration with product, how you assess trade‑offs, and growth related product work.
  • Meet the CEO (30min): At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus’s strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note‑taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note‑takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Referee Operations Manager
description:
Referee Operations Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the guidance of the FIFA Refereeing (Zurich) and Team Services (FIFA27), the Referee Operations Manager will lead the planning and delivery of all referee operations during FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ and related refereeing events. The role is to ensure the excellence of all services required for match officials, fully aligned with FIFA’s Refereeing Requirements, and to guarantee seamless coordination between FIFA Refereeing, Local Team Services and all relevant functional areas.

The Referee Operations Manager will be based in the FIFA 27 headquarters in Rio de Janeiro during the planning stage and at the Referee Base Camp during tournament time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIE

  • Ensure that all operational plans, services, logistics and procedures for Referee Services fully comply with FIFA Refereeing Requirements, delivering the highest standards of service quality to match officials.
  • Operationalise technical and operational needs from FIFA Refereeing into practical, efficient and integrated operational solutions.
  • Lead cross‑functional coordination with all relevant functional areas (FAs) to ensure full integration of Referee Services into tournament operations.
  • Represent Referee Services in operational meetings, workshops, and multi‑stakeholder sessions, ensuring alignment, follow‑up of action points, and consistent internal communication.
  • Coordinate closely with FIFA Refereeing, FIFA Team Services and FIFA27 Team Services for all operational and administrative matters.
  • Assist in preparing and refining Referee Services operational concepts, policies, procedures and service plans.
  • Drive operational readiness for all referee‑related events, including workshops, seminars, test events, inspection visit or any other preparatory activities.
  • Act as the dedicated Refereeing representative for stadium and training site operational planning, ensuring full integration of referee‑specific requirements.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of VAR referee operations at the International Broadcast Center, in coordination with Technology, Broadcast Operations and VAR leadership.
  • Organize the FIFA Referee Cup and Pre‑competition Seminar prior to the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™.
  • Work closely with Workforce, Volunteers and HR on planning, recruiting, onboarding and training temporary staff and volunteers dedicated to Referee Services.
  • Identify, secure and coordinate local football teams to participate in daily practical training sessions with referees.
  • Prepare and deliver training materials, operational manuals and readiness exercises for Referee Services staff and volunteers.
  • Monitor the Referee Services budget in close coordination with Team Services, ensuring efficient and responsible use of resources.
  • Lead the overall project planning for Referee Services, managing timelines, milestones and deliverables across all team members.

Tournament time role

  • Based at the Referee Base Camp, the Referee Operations Manager will transition to a Referee Liaison Officer (RLO) role and will be responsible for:
  • Reporting to and assisting FIFA Refereeing, as required, with all local arrangements (matches, training sessions, meetings, spectating referees, etc).
  • Cooperating with all FAs and service providers to support referees and FIFA Refereeing daily.
  • Coordinating the local players requested for the practical training sessions with the referees.
  • Exchanging information, in particular any last‑minute changes to the daily program, with training site authorities and all FAs involved in the referees’ daily operations.
  • Organizing social activities for the FIFA Refereeing delegation team during the competition, as required.
  • Supervising and coordinating the Referee Services support staff, including the Venue Referee Liaison Officers and volunteers at each stadium.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self‑motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage a group of people working on the same projects and, as required, coordinate people in other functional areas to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem‑solving skills and exercising sound judgment to achieve results.
  • Be very dynamic, stress‑resistant, motivated, excellent interpersonal and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people of other cultures and backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • High energy levels, exceptional planning and organizational skills, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Portuguese and English are mandatory, and Spanish is a great plus.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica náutica com mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo Américas, África, Ásia e Europa. A Mackay oferece salários competitivos, além de horas extras, e benefícios como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias remuneradas, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

A Mackay está buscando um Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) para o setor náutico, com experiência e proficiência em inglês, para trabalhar presencialmente em nossa unidade no Rio de Janeiro. Candidatos com as habilidades e qualificações descritas abaixo são encorajados a se candidatar.

RESUMO DA VAGA DE ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS NO BALCÃO (OTC)

O Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) é um cargo presencial, sem função gerencial, que se reporta ao Diretor Geral do Brasil. As responsabilidades do Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC) incluem, entre outras, a comunicação direta com nossos clientes para responder a perguntas sobre disponibilidade, preço e uso de produtos, bem como fornecer orientação técnica, orçamentos em tempo hábil e propostas abrangentes. Processará transações no balcão, pedidos especiais, pedidos de vendas por telefone e internet, bem como transferências entre empresas. Dará suporte a outros membros da equipe, clientes e contas da empresa com pedidos e entrega de peças para apoiar nossos negócios.

As responsabilidades também incluirão manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias, o que envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO DE ESPECIALISTA EM ATENDIMENTO NO BALCÃO:

  • Atuar como ponto de contato para vendas, serviços e solicitações de informações do cliente para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas com rapidez e profissionalismo.
  • Auxiliar na pesquisa de problemas técnicos básicos sobre produtos e serviços. Coletar sintomas de problemas do cliente e facilitar os reparos.
  • Auxiliar no atendimento de clientes em potencial ou ligações de clientes quando a equipe de vendas externas estiver fora do escritório.
  • Fornecer orçamentos e propostas aos clientes e realizar o acompanhamento em tempo hábil.
  • Desenvolver o negócio identificando oportunidades de receita no setor náutico.
  • Auxiliar nas funções de expedição e recebimento para facilitar o fluxo e a contabilização de todos os materiais recebidos e entregues para pedidos de clientes, estoque, reparos ou uso interno.
  • Direcionar solicitações de serviço ao membro da equipe apropriado.
  • Manter a área de trabalho e o estoque limpos e organizados.
  • Ler pedidos de clientes, ordens de serviço, ordens de envio ou requisições para determinar os itens a serem movidos, coletados, distribuídos e/ou enviados, utilizando o sistema ERP da Mackay.

HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE PRODUTOS DE BANCADA:

  • Conhecimento prévio de equipamentos eletrônicos náuticos é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos como folhetos de produtos, instruções de operação e manutenção, manuais de procedimentos, etc.
  • Capacidade de somar, subtrair, multiplicar e dividir em todas as unidades de medida, utilizando números inteiros, frações comuns e decimais. Capacidade de calcular taxas, proporções e porcentagens.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de organizar materiais de forma eficaz e eficiente.
  • Excelentes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente, comunicação (oral e escrita), organização, planejamento e priorização.

QUALIFICAÇÕES PARA ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS DE MEDICAMENTOS DE BANCADA:

  • Dois anos de ensino superior.
  • Experiência na área de eletrônica e/ou náutica é desejável.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

The Howard University Institute for Advanced Study (HIAS) engages thinkers and scholars at Howard University, in the country, and around the world in addressing deep and persisting racial inequities in areas including, but not limited to, technology, the environment, healthcare, the economy, governance, education, and the criminal legal system. In addition to a residential fellowship program for intellectuals, and a research program, HIAS is home to The Emancipator, an award-winning nonprofit digital magazine that reimagines the nation’s first abolitionist newspapers for a new day. The Emancipator’s mission, like those who came before us, is to leverage the power of journalism to turn public opinion against racist policies and ideas. Together, HIAS plans to enhance the general public’s understanding of racism and evidence-based antiracist solutions through research, collaboration, public lectures, workshops, and outreach programs.

Job Purpose

The Research Assistant conducts research across HIAS’s programmatic areas, including HIAS research projects, the Director’s research projects, and research for The Emancipator. The Research Assistant thrives as both an independent self-starter and an engaged collaborator in a fast-paced team environment. The Research Assistant also provides editorial assistance such as fact-checking and proofreading in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will share a commitment to HIAS’s mission and to delivering accurate, fact-based research and reporting to a public audience. The Research Assistant reports directly to the Research Manager. This position is funded by a one-year grant, with the possibility of renewal.

Supervisory Authority

This role has no direct supervisory authority, but the Research Assistant may be asked to serve as lead on projects related to helping promote HIAS's mission and goals.

Nature And Scope

This position will interact with faculty, staff, students, and internal and external contacts.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct research for HIAS research projects, for the Director’s research projects, and The Emancipator's reporting
  • Fact-check research products and Emancipator content prior to submission and publication
  • Monitor and report to the Research Manager and Managing Editor on newsworthy studies and research

Collaboration And Communication

  • Communicate daily with the Research Manager and as needed with editors and journalists at The Emancipator to receive work assignments and report any necessary updates

Core Competencies

Technical Proficiency

  • Skilled in historical research and fact-checking
  • Adept at locating important documents and navigating online databases and journals
  • Experience creating academic citations in the Chicago Manual of Style
  • Competency in reading and synthesizing research and other content outside of individual’s field of expertise

Attention To Detail

  • Meticulous in reviewing content for factual and copy-editing errors
  • Proven and constant commitment to ensuring accuracy
  • Expertise in identifying reputable and reliable sourcing

Organizational Skills

  • Effectively manage time to meet assigned project deadlines
  • Handle multiple assignments and adjust priorities based on project needs

Analytical Thinking

  • Stay attuned to the historical throughlines in current events
  • Observe historiographical and other research trends

Communication Skills

  • Clear, effective, and collegial written and verbal communication

Collaborative Skills

  • Work effectively and efficiently without constant supervision while also being a collaborative contributor to larger projects and the team at large

Adaptability

  • Flexibility to shift from project to project on short notice, and sometimes with a quick turnaround

Minimum Requirements

  • Based in the Washington D.C. metro area.
  • Education: B.A. or M.A. in History, African American Studies, or a related field
  • Historical research background in racist policies and/or practices
  • Knowledge of proper research methods and proper citation practices (Chicago Manual of Style)
  • Experience locating historical documents, secondary research, and navigating relevant archives and databases
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills

Compensation Range: $50,000 - $55,000

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff 'for fit' makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

About HIAS

The Howard University Institute for Advanced Study (HIAS) engages thinkers and scholars at Howard University, in the country, and around the world in addressing deep and persisting racial inequities in technology, the environment, healthcare, the economy, governance, education, and the criminal legal system.

In addition to a residential fellowship program for intellectuals, and a research program, HIAS is home to The Emancipator, an award-winning nonprofit digital magazine that reimagines the nation’s first abolitionist newspapers for a new day. The Emancipator’s mission is to leverage the power of journalism to turn public opinion against racist policies and ideas.

Together, HIAS plans to enhance the general public’s understanding of racism and evidence‑based antiracist solutions through research, collaboration, public lectures, workshops, and outreach programs.

Job Purpose

The Social Media Coordinator acts as a conduit between scholars, researchers, journalists, and the public by creating engaging and impactful social media content that shares the work of HIAS across its programmatic areas. The Social Media Coordinator creates and posts social media content that is mission-focused, sharp, timely, relevant, fast, deftly researched and vetted, and well produced. This work includes posts in support of the HIAS Director, its research program and public events, and The Emancipator’s regular daily news coverage. The Social Media Coordinator will have experience producing high-quality content at a high output. The ideal candidate will share a commitment to the mission of HIAS and possess an ability to identify what events or stories are newsworthy, as well as an instinct for the historical implications of current events. The Social Media Coordinator reports directly to the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research. This position is funded by a one‑year grant, with the possibility of renewal.

Supervisory Authority

While this role has no direct supervisory authority, the Social Media Coordinator may be asked to help mentor student interns and/or student employees. This role may be asked to serve as lead on projects related to helping promote the mission and goals of HIAS.

Nature and Scope

This position will interact with faculty, staff, students, and internal and external contacts.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Create and post regular (daily and weekly) content, as directed, that promotes mission and work of HIAS
  • Attend and create content for HIAS’s public events
  • Pitch timely, relevant, mission‑aligned content
  • Adhere to operational structure and workflows
  • Adhere to the publishing calendar and cadence
  • Utilize editorial support services such as webpage hosting, photos, videos, Slack, and social media

Collaboration and Communication

  • Collaborate with the research team and the Emancipator team on content creation
  • Work with the HIAS Director, Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research, and the editors of The Emancipator to execute a social media strategy
  • Help maintain a collegial and professional working environment
  • Coordinate with other departments or external partners when necessary and directed
  • Communicate collegially, clearly and effectively, both in writing and verbally

Professional Development and Media Appearances

  • Collaborate with Director and Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research and, where applicable, the Howard University public relations office, on media engagement
  • Identify professional development opportunities such as conferences, lectures, and speaking engagements alongside the Director and Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research

Core Competencies

Technical Proficiency

  • Highly skilled in high-impact content creation for a sizable audience across various platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Squarespace‑hosted websites
  • Proficient at creating and editing graphics and videos for social media
  • Proficient in CMS, news analytics tools, social media platforms, video and photo databases
  • Skilled in navigating government, public records, and archival databases

Attention to Detail

  • Sharp and highly experienced news judgment
  • Meticulous in handling and publishing content
  • Diligent in producing accurate, timely, well‑reported, vetted, and sourced content

Organizational Skills

  • Effectively manage time to meet project deadlines
  • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities based on project needs

Analytical Thinking

  • Offer solutions to workflow challenges and inefficiencies
  • Track, monitor, and analyze user engagement across platforms and report findings to the Chief of Staff/Associate Director of Research and the Managing Editor of The Emancipator

Communication Skills

  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication
  • Provide instructions and feedback to students or junior staff

Collaborative Skills

  • Work well within a team and contribute to group projects
  • Ability to “manage up” with higher level leadership

Adaptability

  • Flexibly adapt to new technologies and methods
  • Continuously learn and seek professional development
  • Handle multiple tasks and adjust priorities as needed

Project Management

  • Oversee content from inception to completion
  • Track progress and report on outcomes

Minimum Requirements

  • Based in the Washington D.C. metro area
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or higher
  • Minimum 3 years of social media content production experience in a newsroom setting
  • Experienced at creating and editing graphics and videos for social media
  • Demonstrated social media production on race and justice editorial content
  • Demonstrated ability to participate on teams of varied sizes–including those that include freelancers/contributors
  • Demonstrated experience in directly producing breaking‑news style social media content
  • Knowledge of digital publishing protocols and analytics
  • Experience with CMS and social media production and digital editing software
  • Strong attention to detail and organization accuracy with recordkeeping
  • Troubleshooting and problem-solving expertise
  • Demonstrated initiative to work self‑directed yet with a collaborative style
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills

Compensation Range: $60,000 - $70,000

Job Purpose

The Annual Giving Program & Operations Coordinator is a key team member within the Office of Annual Giving. The incumbent will manage responsibilities that are integral to the success of the office and the growth of the annual giving program. The Coordinator will support the planning, coordination, and execution of multi-channel fundraising campaigns, including direct mail, email, digital, and engagement-based initiatives. The incumbent will provide reliable and professional support to the Annual Giving team, assisting with project coordination, data management, reporting, and campaign operations. This role will work closely with the Director of Annual Giving and Assistant Directors to support reunion and constituent-based fundraising efforts, campaign execution, and donor engagement activities. The Coordinator will apply skills and knowledge to support a broad range of projects and operational tasks, while developing an understanding of annual giving strategy, fundraising processes, and donor engagement practices. This position provides the incumbent with opportunities for professional growth and exposure across the Annual Giving and Development functions.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

The Annual Giving Program & Operations Coordinator will collaborate closely with the Annual Giving team, Advancement Services, Alumni Relations, and other campus partners to support the planning and execution of fundraising initiatives. This role will interact with internal stakeholders across Development and Alumni Relations, as well as external vendors and partners supporting campaign production, digital platforms, and donor engagement efforts. The Coordinator will play a key role in ensuring alignment across campaign timelines, data processes, and reporting.

Principal Accountabilities

Campaign & Project Coordination

  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of multi-channel annual giving campaigns, including direct mail, email, digital, and crowdfunding initiatives
  • Maintain and manage the Annual Giving campaign calendar, ensuring alignment across projects, deadlines, and stakeholders
  • Coordinate campaign workflows, timelines, and deliverables across internal teams and external vendors
  • Assist in quality assurance processes, including reviewing campaign assets, links, and data outputs

Data & Reporting Support

  • Assist with data requests, list preparation, segmentation support, and quality control in partnership with Advancement Services
  • Support campaign tracking, reporting, and performance analysis across all Annual Giving initiatives
  • Prepare regular reports and dashboards to support decision-making and program evaluation
  • Maintain accurate records of campaign activity, results, and donor engagement

Program Support (Reunion & Affinity Giving)

  • Support reunion and affinity-based giving efforts through coordination of outreach, materials, and communications
  • Assist with donor and prospect research, briefing materials, and stewardship tracking
  • Coordinate logistics and communications related to volunteer engagement and special projects
  • Provide project support for targeted fundraising initiatives and special campaigns

Operations & Administrative Support

  • Support the Director of Annual Giving with campaign planning, meeting coordination, and operational follow-up

title: Benefits & Retirement Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Manager, Benefits & Retirement is responsible for the overall administration, compliance, and strategic oversight of employee benefit and retirement programs, including health & welfare and defined benefit and defined contribution plans. This role serves as a key resource to employees, leadership, and vendors to ensure effective delivery, compliance, and optimization of all benefit offerings.

Supervisory Authority

Role will supervise a Team of Benefits Analyst and/or Benefits Partners.

Nature And Scope

Position regularly collaborates with external vendors, internal HR partners, HU Hospital staff, and leads public-facing events to educate the university community on benefits, wellness programs, and related initiatives.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in overseeing and manages the administration of all employee benefit and retirement programs, including health & welfare plans (medical, dental, vision, life, disability) and Defined Benefit and Defined Contribution plans (403(b), 457). Ensures effective service delivery, vendor performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensures compliance with all applicable federal and state regulations (e.g., ERISA, HIPAA, ACA, FMLA), including oversight of government filings (e.g., Form 5500), audits, plan documents, and required notices for both benefits and retirement programs.
  • Leads employee education and counseling efforts for the retirement programs, including retirement readiness. Serves as escalation point for complex participant inquiries.
  • Oversees retirement and pension application processing, including eligibility review, benefit calculations, and coordination with actuaries to validate calculations and payment options.
  • Administers and oversees processes related to QDROs, beneficiary claims, pension refunds, and monthly retirement payments, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Analyzes benefits and retirement data, trends, and discrepancies; supports audits; and develops recommendations to improve plan performance, cost efficiency, and employee experience.
  • Supports annual open enrollment planning, benefits communications, and implementation of plan changes or enhancements.

Core Competencies

  • Expert knowledge of federal and state laws governing employee benefits and retirement programs, including ERISA, HIPAA, ACA, FMLA, and QDRO requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of both health & welfare benefit plans and defined benefit and defined contribution retirement plans.
  • Knowledge of current industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes in benefits and retirement programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply complex policies, regulations, and plan provisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse populations.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Proficiency in HRIS systems and standard business software applications.
  • Ability to manage a team of staff.

Minimum Requirements

Education: Associate Degree in a related field from an accredited college or university is required, combined with significant relevant experience. Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field is preferred. Experience: Minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in employee benefits and/or retirement plan administration, including health & welfare and defined benefit and defined contribution plans, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $100,000 - $109,000

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Process Support Engineer with a strong commercial mindset and solid process engineering experience within the oil and gas industry.

This role combines topside process engineering expertise with the ability to identify optimization opportunities, assess production assets, and translate technical diagnostics into value-generating business solutions for clients.

The professional will evaluate onshore and offshore production units, conduct technical audits, identify operational bottlenecks, and propose innovative, economically viable solutions focused on asset optimization.

  • Conduct technical and operational audits of oil and gas production assets.

  • Translate technical findings into structured value propositions and improvement initiatives.
  • Develop optimization roadmaps focused on operational efficiency and economic return.
  • Support aftermarket services, brownfield projects, and topside modifications.
  • Interface directly with Operations, Engineering teams, suppliers, and clients to gain firsthand familiarity of customer needs plus product applications.

  • Evaluate customer support issues as well as maintain top level positive perception by customers pertinent to organization support structure.

  • Participate in sales support related conferences, trade shows, workshops plus meetings to update on current information plus developments in industry.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Petroleum, Production, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering or related disciplines.
  • CREA active

Experience

  • Proven experience as aProcess Engineer within the oil and gas industry.
  • Experience working onboard offshore units and/or onshore production facilities.
  • Background in process audits, performance evaluation, and operational efficiency analysis.

Core Technical Knowledge

  • Oil, gas, and water separation systems.
  • Strong expertise in managing gas production operations and processes: topside, refining, downstrime, production platforms.
  • Gas treatment systems (H₂S/CO₂ removal via amine or membrane systems, dehydration, compression).
  • Produced water treatment systems.
  • Heat exchangers, pressure vessels, filtration systems, and utilities.
  • Familiarity with amine systems, membranes, fixed-bed scavengers, and hybrid process configurations.

Sobre o Grupo Sony Music Entertainment Brasil

O Grupo Sony Music Entertainment Brasil é um dos principais grupos de entretenimento do país, parte do grupo global Sony Music Entertainment. Nossa missão é impulsionar a música e a cultura, conectando artistas e fãs por meio de inovação, criatividade e excelência em execução. Atuamos em todas as frentes do mercado fonográfico, do desenvolvimento de novos talentos à valorização de um catálogo icônico, sempre com o objetivo de inspirar e transformar através da música.

A área de dados do Grupo trabalha com dados de streaming dos produtos Sony e Som Livre nos parceiros digitais (Spotify, Deezer, Amazon Music, Apple Music, etc.) e com dados de charts do mercado. O time é responsável por todo o gerenciamento desses dados, realizando o processo de análise de ponta a ponta: desde a extração e limpeza, passando pela criação de lógicas e métricas, transformação de bases, automatização de processos, desenvolvimento de visualizações e dashboards, até a geração de insights e apresentação de análises com direcionamentos práticos para a tomada de decisão da companhia.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Business Intelligence apaixonado(a) por música e profundamente conectado(a) ao universo digital, que atuará diretamente nesse ecossistema de dados, contribuindo com análises, organização de informações e geração de insights estratégicos para o negócio.

O que você fará:

  • Atualizações de rotina;
  • Manutenção e desenvolvimento de scripts de Python, fluxos de Alteryx, visualizações e dashboards no Tableau e Power BI;
  • Elaboração de relatórios sobre a Sony e o mercado;
  • Desenvolvimento de análises;
  • Ama música e é usuária/o frequente de plataformas de streaming;
  • É uma pessoa focada em resultados e nos principais KPIs da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Python/R: Conhecimentos Essenciais: saber desenvolver lógicas e manipular data frames com as funções, ferramentas e pacotes necessários. (Conhecimentos Diferenciais: Web Scraping e chamadas em APIs);
  • Power BI: para criar visualizações e fazer a manutenção e criação de dashboards;
  • SQL Básico: para fazer extrações nas bases de dados da Sony;
  • Inglês: avançado para acompanhar e fazer apresentações em inglês e se comunicar com os times do exterior (em reuniões e e-mails);

  • Visão analítica e pensamento crítico: para desenvolver análises;
  • Curiosidade e vontade de aprender : para aprender sobre o mercado da música, novas ferramentas e ajudar a trazer soluções no dia a dia;

O que oferecemos a você:

  • Você se junta a uma comunidade inclusiva, colaborativa e global, onde tem a oportunidade de canalizar sua paixão todos os dias;

description:

Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation

Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.

  • Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
  • Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
  • Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
  • Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
  • Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
  • Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
  • Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
  • Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
  • Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detaildesign projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
  • Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register).
  • Hands‑on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.g., SIMOPS, ALARP).
  • Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
  • Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
  • A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter‑discipline communication skills.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Oncology Clinical Researcher
description:
About The Job

At Alignerr, we partner with the world’s leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models. We are seeking an Oncology Clinical Researcher to bring deep expertise in cancer clinical trials into AI‑driven research and evaluation workflows. In this role, you will ensure that oncology trial data used to train and assess advanced AI systems reflects real‑world regulatory, scientific, and clinical standards.

Organization: Alignerr | Position: Oncology Clinical Researcher | Type: Hourly Contract | Compensation: $40–$80 /hour | Location: Remote | Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You’ll Do

  • Design and run oncology clinical trials by developing study protocols, overseeing patient enrollment, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and ethical standards.
  • Analyze cancer trial data, including safety, efficacy, and biomarker results, to evaluate how well treatments perform.
  • Translate trial outcomes into regulatory and scientific reports used for FDA/EMA submissions, publications, and clinical decision‑making.
  • Review and evaluate AI‑generated clinical insights for accuracy, clinical relevance, and regulatory alignment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience designing and managing oncology clinical trials from protocol development through data readout.
  • Strong background in analyzing oncology clinical data, including endpoints, safety profiles, and biomarkers.
  • Familiarity with regulatory submission standards for agencies such as the FDA or EMA.

Preferred

  • Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems

Why Join Us

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Work directly on frontier AI systems transforming cancer research.
  • Influence how AI models understand and reason about real oncology data.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.

Application Process (Takes 15–20 min)

  • Submit your resume
  • Complete a short screening
  • Project matching and onboarding

PS: Our team reviews applications daily. Please complete your AI interview and application steps to be considered for this opportunity.
